title: Astragaloside IV attenuates atherosclerosis by regulating endothelial mitophagy and oxidative stress via the Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin pathway.
authors: Chai, Chang; Liu, Dandan; Li, Yanjie; Gao, Yang; Zhao, Yiting; Qin, Hewei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪甲苷IV通过Nrf2/PINK1/Parkin通路调控线粒体自噬减轻动脉粥样硬化，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白（Keap1）互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Astragaloside IV (AS-IV) exhibits cardiovascular protective effects, but its role in mitochondrial quality control during atherosclerosis remains unclear. This study evaluated whether AS-IV attenuates atherosclerosis by regulating the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)-PTEN-induced putative kinase 1 (PINK1)/Parkin pathway. High-fat diet-fed apolipoprotein E-deficient (ApoE(-/-)) mice and oxidized low-density lipoprotein (ox-LDL)-treated human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) were used as in vivo and in vitro models. AS-IV reduced aortic plaque burden and alleviated endothelial injury in ApoE(-/-) mice. In HUVECs, AS-IV decreased oxidative stress and improved mitochondrial function, accompanied by enhanced mitophagy. Mechanistically, AS-IV promoted Nrf2 nuclear translocation and upregulated the PINK1/Parkin axis. Silencing Nrf2 or PINK1, or pharmacological inhibition of Nrf2 with ML385, abolished the cytoprotective effects of AS-IV and suppressed mitophagy. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations provided supportive structural context for a plausible AS-IV pose within the Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) pocket in the simulated system. Mechanistically, AS-IV appears to mitigate atherosclerotic progression by promoting Nrf2-driven, PINK1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy.
abstract_zh: 黄芪甲苷（Astragaloside IV, AS-IV）具有心血管保护作用，但其在动脉粥样硬化过程中对线粒体质量控制的作用尚不清楚。本研究评估了AS-IV是否通过调控核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）-PTEN诱导推定激酶1（PINK1）/Parkin通路来减轻动脉粥样硬化。采用高脂饮食喂养的载脂蛋白E缺陷（ApoE(-/-)）小鼠和氧化低密度脂蛋白（ox-LDL）处理的人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）作为体内和体外模型。AS-IV减少了ApoE(-/-)小鼠的主动脉斑块负担并缓解了内皮损伤。在HUVECs中，AS-IV降低了氧化应激并改善了线粒体功能，同时伴有线粒体自噬增强。机制上，AS-IV促进了Nrf2核转位并上调了PINK1/Parkin轴。沉默Nrf2或PINK1，或使用ML385药理学抑制Nrf2，消除了AS-IV的细胞保护作用并抑制了线粒体自噬。分子对接和分子动力学模拟为AS-IV在模拟系统中Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）口袋内的可能结合构象提供了支持性结构背景。机制上，AS-IV似乎通过促进Nrf2驱动的、PINK1/Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬来减轻动脉粥样硬化的进展。
